## Public repository checklist

- [ ] Stable policy remains provider- and model-neutral.
- [ ] Concrete model choices appear only in dated profiles or qualification evidence.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private source, raw prompts/responses, complete logs or personal paths.
- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots use synthetic identities and sanitized data.
- [ ] Security-sensitive reports use a private advisory rather than this PR.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes tests, host qualification and live dogfood evidence.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete staged diff and take responsibility for the submitted content.
